component.name: Zellij
component.summary: Terminal workspace with panes, tabs, sessions and an inbox

description.p: Zellij is a terminal workspace. It splits a window into panes and tabs, keeps sessions running when the window closes, and brings them back later.

It runs inside any terminal, or as its own app with a window, a tray icon and desktop notifications that tell you when a command finishes, fails or needs you. The inbox gathers everything that needs you across sessions.

ul.li: Panes, tabs, floating panes and layouts
Sessions that keep running when you close the window
An inbox and status symbols for commands that finish, fail or wait for you
Plugins written in any language that compiles to WebAssembly
